## 🛳️ Mundra Port – Overview

### Type
Mundra Port is a **deep-water, all-weather, berthing-on-arrival port** located in the Gulf of Kutch. It is also a **private port** and a **Special Economic Zone (SEZ)**.

### Location
Mundra Port is the **largest commercial and container port in India**, located on the **northern shores of the Gulf of Kutch**, near Mundra, Kutch district, **Gujarat**.

### Ownership & Operation
It is **India's first private port**, formerly operated by Mundra Port and Special Economic Zone Limited (MPSEZ) under the ownership of the **Adani Group**, and was later expanded to become **Adani Ports & SEZ Limited (APSEZ)**.

### Port Code
The port code for Mundra is **INMUN**, and it is classified as a **Seaport**, located at Latitude **22° 45' 0" N** and Longitude **69° 38' 0" E**.

---

### 📦 Cargo Handled
Mundra Port is an **all-weather port** handling **crude oil, containers, dry bulk, breakbulk, automobiles, and liquid cargo**.

### 🏗️ Infrastructure
Mundra Port operates **26 berths** across multiple specialized terminals with a total capacity of **228 MMTPA**. The facility includes four container terminals handling **7.5 million TEUs** annually, equipped with **deep-water berths up to 19 meters draft**, an automated liquid terminal with 97 tanks, dedicated coal and bulk cargo terminals, and automobile handling facilities.

### 📊 Cargo Volume
The port currently handles over **155 MT** — the highest in India — constituting nearly **11% of India's total annual maritime cargo**, and handles nearly **33% of India's container traffic**.

### 🌍 Global Connectivity
Mundra Port in Gujarat offers **direct connectivity to major global markets** including the **US East Coast, Europe, Middle East, and Africa**. It is served by all major global shipping lines, including **Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd, COSCO, and Evergreen**.

### 🏆 Ranking
Mundra Port is **among the top 30 busiest container ports globally**.
